items.title: X Money: Earn 5% Back On Up To $1,000 In Debit Card Purchases (11/23 – 11/30)
items.why: Short-term debit cashback sets a rewards benchmark for everyday spend; watch whether premium issuers respond with matching offers.
items.summary_ai: X Money is offering 5% cash back on up to $1,000 of debit card purchases from November 23 to 30, above its usual 3%.
items.take: Short-term debit cashback sets a rewards benchmark for everyday spend; watch whether premium issuers respond with matching offers.
